items.raw_excerpt: Rows of black and white plastic weed mats are giving vegetable seedlings their best start in life. But disposing of them has become a logistical and cost burden.
items.summary_en: Plastic weed mats help vegetable seedlings grow, but farmers have no good way to dispose of them. The mounting waste has become a costly problem for farms across Australia.
items.summary_ko: 잡초 방지용 플라스틱 매트가 모종 재배에 도움을 주지만, 폐기 처리에 어려움을 겪고 있다. 호주 전역 농장에서 플라스틱 폐기물 증가가 비용과 물류 부담으로 이어지고 있다.
items.title_en: Farmers struggle with plastic weed mat waste
items.title_ko: 호주 농민들, 농업용 플라스틱 폐기물 처리에 골머리
items.title_original: Farmers seek solution to mounting plastic waste problem

items.raw_excerpt: Some of the Island's oldest burial grounds are at risk, as coastal erosion washes away the land beneath them. People are doing what they can to protect those cemeteries but, as CBC's Cody MacKay explains, eventually they will be lost to the sea.
items.summary_en: Coastal erosion is washing away land beneath Prince Edward Island's oldest burial grounds. People are trying to protect the cemeteries, but the graves will eventually be lost to the sea.
items.summary_ko: 프린스에드워드아일랜드에서 해안 침식으로 가장 오래된 무덤들이 있는 땅이 바다로 씻겨 나가고 있습니다. 주민들은 무덤들을 지키기 위해 노력하고 있지만 결국 바다에 잠길 운명입니다.
items.title_en: Erosion washes away P.E.I.'s historic gravesites
items.title_ko: PEI 해안 침식으로 옛 무덤들이 바다로 사라져
items.title_original: Erosion is washing away some of P.E.I.’s historical gravesites

items.raw_excerpt: En Valparaíso ya comenzó la transformación de la Plaza del Pueblo y sus alrededores, en específico a la vereda que comparte con el Parque Italia y también hasta el boulevard de calle Victoria, entre avenida Francia y calle General Cruz. El proyecto busca devolver a la comunidad un espacio más accesible, seguro y moderno. La iniciativa, impulsada por Serviu Valparaíso, contempla una inversión superior a los $1.300 millones y se extenderá hasta diciembre de 2026. Entre las principales obras destac
items.summary_en: The Plaza del Pueblo in Valparaíso is getting a major makeover with new lighting, accessibility features and landscaping. The government project invests over 1.3 billion pesos and will run until December 2026.
items.summary_ko: 칠레 발파라이소의 플라사 델 푸에블로가 새 조명과 장애인 접근 시설, 조경 공사를 통해 대대적으로 탈바꿈한다. 이 정부 프로젝트는 13억 페소 이상이 투입되었으며 2026년 12월까지 진행된다.
items.title_en: Valparaíso's Plaza del Pueblo gets new lights, paths and green spaces

items.raw_excerpt: Located at Orchard Rendezvous Hotel, the new cocktail bar serves more than 50 martinis, from classic recipes to contemporary creations, in a space inspired by the golden age of luxury rail travel.
items.summary_en: A new cocktail bar has opened at Orchard Rendezvous Hotel in Singapore. It offers more than 50 martini recipes, from classic to modern, in a space inspired by luxury rail travel.

items.summary_en: Deputy Regional Governor Giannis Androulakis held a work meeting in Lasithi, Crete, about water resource use and geological research in Kalo Chorio. The study presented covers geophysical and geological exploration in the municipality of Agios Nikolaos.
